Spec 09 Better Graphics, reopened twice more — semantic diff

Branch feature/better-graphicsBase ef31576Head 46b29e0 Target main (PR #36)Date 2026-11-23 Commits 28Files 246 · +11924 / −2261 Written by REVIEW: + CODE REVIEW: · Claude Opus 5.5

Summary

The range ef31576..HEAD holds two reopenings of spec 09 and the kit regeneration. Part M (Steps 30-37) makes Echo, Flarekid and the new MagMax animated picture fighters from the author's delivery; parts P, H, X and E (Steps 38-49) bring the author's Glimmer Isles palette pack, four colour variations on C, four more camera views with screen-relative controls, and Beatbolt2, Echo rebuilt in 3D from shapes. The work is careful, measured and well tested (604 tests); the open points are about the look in the new default, not about rules.

  • Echo, Flarekid and MagMax now turn, walk and shoot in play with their delivered frames and projectiles, show off on the pedestal and live on their cards; the hero pictures left the export.
  • Glimmer Isles takes the author's palette and materials by role (no re-bake); C switches Original (the look before, pixel-close), Glimmer (the default), Lagoon and Glow night in both worlds.
  • V and 1-8 go through eight views; keys, sticks, aim and the animated fighters' facing follow the screen through the camera's yaw, so W is up the screen in Side, Diagonal and Cinematic too.
  • Beatbolt2 is a 99-shape model joined into 42 meshes, so four of him stay within L8's draw calls; his comparison sheets are in docs/screenshots/beatbolt2/ (6.92 MB).
  • In the new default (Glimmer, Bright day) the light floor tiles and the border tops render as pure white, the pack's sky is not seen in Bright day (Low sees the preset's blue), and Classic is milky from the pack's fog.

Recommendation: Approve with follow-ups — 0 Blocking; the white floor (finding 1) is a fix-now colour choice, P4's sky and L8's 33 ms rule (findings 2 and 4) need a decision before CLOSE:.

2026_11_21_09_better_graphics_spec.md — parts M (M1-M16, Steps 30-37, D34-D43), P (P1-P8), H (H1-H8), X (X1-X8) and E (E1-E8) (Steps 38-49, D44-D57); S2-S6. The kit regeneration (325b5a1, a268200) is not part of the spec and is reviewed as configuration and tooling.

Author Q&A

Why does Glimmer Isles' Classic preset look milky now?
P4 asks Classic to show the pack's environment as delivered; its fog whitens the arena. Step 40 kept fog and glow after seeing them on the desktop and the web. Finding 3 asks for a decision.
Why are the pack's sky colours not seen in Bright day?
Step 40 found no view that sees the sky and kept the presets' 30 % world share. Low (Step 44) does see it, and it shows Bright day's blue. Finding 2.
Why is docs/screenshots/beatbolt2/ 6.92 MB?
D54's about 3 MB covered the rounds (3.45 MB); Step 48 added the motion sheet and eight view sheets as PNG. Not exported (.gdignore). Finding 5.
Are the kit commits part of spec 09?
No: 325b5a1 and a268200 regenerate the shared kit and add a root spec; they are on this branch, so PR #36 carries them. Finding 8.

Highlights

1 · C switches the colour variation of the built arena

hack_star_godot/scenes/arena.gd:263-282 · 7ee9da9 · Step 41 · H1, H5, H6, D48

263## The world built in the arena (`Canyon` or `GlimmerIsles`).
264func world() -> Node3D:
265 if has_node("GlimmerIsles"):
266 return get_node("GlimmerIsles")
267 return get_node("Canyon")
268
269
270## Gives the world the colour variation `variation_id` (spec 09 H1–H6, D48), kept for the next
271## match and Training, and names it in the toast: the world repaints itself and lights the arena
272## with its own light again, then the lighting preset and the boost apply on top as before; the
273## view and the camera stay.
274func set_colour_variation(variation_id: String) -> void:
275 if not ColourVariations.has(variation_id):
276 return
277 world().call(Object.call — Calls a method by name at run time; used here because the world is a Canyon or a GlimmerIsles node with no shared typed base, both with apply_variation."apply_variation", variation_id)
278 GameState.colour_variation = variation_id
279 _lighting.setupWorldLighting.setup — Remembers the environment and sun the world just built as its own light, so the preset and boost apply on top of the new variation (H6).($WorldEnvironment, $Sun)
280 _lighting.apply(GameState.light_preset, GameState.saturation_boost)
281 _toast.show_text(ColourVariations.title(variation_id))
282

What changed: set_colour_variation asks the world to repaint itself, then lights the arena again and applies the preset and the boost on top; the toast names the variation. Why it matters: One path for every variation and world, no scene rebuild, so the view, the fighters and the colliders stay (P6). Check: world() returns GlimmerIsles when present; the dynamic call() is untyped (both worlds must keep apply_variation).

2 · GlimmerIsles.apply_variation repaints by role, no re-bake

hack_star_godot/scenes/worlds/glimmer_isles/glimmer_isles.gd:73-94 · 7ee9da9 · Step 41 · H1, H2, P6, D45, D48

73## Gives the built world the colours and the own light of the colour variation `variation_id`
74## (spec 09 H1, D48): every surface, baked part and decoration repainted by its role, the lagoon
75## added or removed, the arena's environment and sun lit again; nothing moves, no collider is
76## touched. The arena then applies the lighting preset again (`WorldLighting`).
77func apply_variation(variation_id: String) -> void:
78 variation = variation_id

Concepts glossary

Object.call
Calls a method by name at run time; used here because the world is a Canyon or a GlimmerIsles node with no shared typed base, both with apply_variation.
WorldLighting.setup
Remembers the environment and sun the world just built as its own light, so the preset and boost apply on top of the new variation (H6).
GeometryInstance3D.material_override
A material that replaces every surface material of the mesh; swapping it repaints a built mesh without rebuilding it.
Object.get_meta
Reads a value stored on a node with set_meta; here the role and outline each mesh was built with.
Node.queue_free
Deletes the node at the end of the frame, safe while it may still be drawn; the lagoon is removed and rebuilt only where the variation has one.
Environment adjustments
Brightness, contrast and saturation applied after tone mapping; the pack ships its own colour boost, kept in Classic and multiplied by K.
Environment fog
Depth fog blended over the scene; the pack's fog stays in Classic and is switched off in the other presets.
Tone mapping
How HDR light is squeezed to the screen; the presets use linear, the pack's Classic its filmic mapping.
PackedScene.instantiate
Builds the nodes of a saved scene; here the pack's lighting scene, read for its environment and sun and then freed.
Resource.duplicate
A copy of a resource; the arena changes the copy, so the pack's .tres is never modified at run time.
Color.lerp
Mixes two colours by a weight; the fill light's violet is folded into the ambient by the two energies, because the toon bands hardly show the omni light.
Object.free
Deletes the instance at once; it was never added to the tree.
Basis axes
The columns of a Basis are the node's right, up and back axes; the right axis stays level however far the camera looks down, so its angle is the yaw.
atan2
The angle of a vector from its two components, correct in every quadrant; it turns the right axis into rotation.y.
Vector2.rotated
Turns a 2D vector by an angle in radians; screen-to-world is a turn by minus the yaw, world-to-screen by the yaw.
Input.get_vector
Reads four actions as one 2D vector with dead zones; it is the direction on the screen.
Node3D.global_transform
The camera's position and basis in the world, read every frame, so the yaw is right during a blend and Cinematic's swing.
FighterModel.play_shoot
Shows the shoot frame of the view of the shot's direction on the screen for 0.25 s; a fighter of shapes ignores it.
Lazy loading
The projectile picture is loaded on first use and cached per fighter (D36), so only fighters in play take memory.
Viewport.get_camera_3d
The camera that draws this viewport; the fighter reads its yaw, so the bots (moved on the ground) face by the screen too.
Node.is_inside_tree
True once the node is in the scene tree; model tests without a viewport keep the plain direction.
Mesh.surface_get_arrays
The vertex, normal and index arrays of one surface; primitive meshes have one indexed surface.
Normal matrix
Normals of a stretched shape must be turned by the inverse transpose of its basis, or the lighting and the outline go wrong.
ArrayMesh.add_surface_from_arrays
Builds a mesh surface from arrays; one mesh per material and group draws once with its outline instead of once per part.
Static hook
Calls the look file's static animate(model, time, state) when it has one; FighterModel stays under gdlint's 1000 lines (991).
Emission energy
How strongly a standard material glows; the pack's values were tuned for the standard shader with filmic tone mapping and wash the toon shader to white.
Per-instance glow
A toon shader switch: a MultiMesh instance glows in its own instance colour, used by the canyon's flowers in Glow night.
Export exclude filter
Comma-separated globs of project files left out of the .pck; checked against the exported .pck in this review (none of the excluded names inside).
